runtime_boundary.rule: Missing Git-ignored evidence is pending/unavailable; never fabricate replacement metrics.

experiments.title: SM/FSM full-market baseline
experiments.question: Do the original SM/FSM-era strategies remain useful across a frozen full-market universe?
experiments.decision: A reproducible comparison and research candidate were established, but stable broad outperformance was not demonstrated; Naive remains a required control.
experiments.gate: Full-run data freshness, source manifest, execution-cost, coverage, and market-local reporting contracts.
limitations: US and CN_A conclusions are independent.
A ranking is not a return promise.
Small-sample segment winners are research leads only.

experiments.title: Transformer feasibility and state retrieval
experiments.question: Does state similarity/retrieval improve expert utility enough to justify Transformer work?
experiments.decision: Engineering evidence passed, but query utility did not; Phase 2 STOP prevented Transformer training and product integration.
experiments.gate: Primary state_match_balanced matched coverage >= 30%; v3 query utility/regret must beat the random-neighbor control under the predeclared test.
limitations: Similarity consistency was misaligned with realized expert utility.
No Transformer effectiveness claim is allowed.

experiments.title: Adaptive routing and dynamic expert systems
experiments.question: Can adaptive routing or a dynamic expert ensemble earn admission beyond frozen controls?
experiments.decision: Phase A-F artifacts completed, but W11 non-inferiority breadth reached only US 1/4 and CN_A 2/4; W12 product admission was blocked.
experiments.gate: Four test splits; at least 3/4 non-inferior windows; no worse drawdown; turnover <= 1.25x adaptive control.
limitations: Research-only; no shadow mode or Streamlit integration.
Market-specific artifacts cannot be substituted across markets.

experiments.title: CN_A Composite-only
experiments.question: Does market-native CN_A Composite beat SM/FSM under one frozen comparison?
experiments.decision: Composite passed the CN_A research gate, but remains research-only and market-local.
experiments.gate: Sharpe above baseline; fold consistency >= 75%; at least one risk improvement; unified market/universe/fold/horizon/execution contract; traceable manifest.
limitations: One frozen universe and four-fold comparison.
Advisory was not part of this gate.

experiments.title: CN_A Composite plus multi-expert advisory
experiments.question: Can advisory experts reduce Composite risk without changing its direction or opening unauthorized positions?
experiments.decision: The immutable contract, advisory policies, safety bounds, and tests are complete; no real-data pass is recorded because the expected advisory manifest and ablation outputs are absent.
experiments.gate: Sharpe decline <= 10%; at least one risk improvement; turnover <= 30%; fallback/audit quality acceptable.
limitations: Framework completion is not empirical improvement.
Do not merge advisory into Composite-only evidence.

experiments.title: ML Enhancement and Parameter Optimization
experiments.question: Can Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, and LightGBM filtering improve parameter search?
experiments.decision: ML-enhanced variants integrated as research-optional features.

experiments.title: US Composite (Phase 0-4)
experiments.question: Can US Composite with macro factors beat SM/FSM?

experiments.title: News fusion and sentiment factors
experiments.question: Can leakage-safe news sentiment be added as an optional signal without breaking missing-data behavior?
experiments.decision: News fusion was integrated as an optional research branch; missing coverage uses explicit fallback and is not treated as evidence of uplift.
experiments.gate: Schema, coverage, duplicate/future-date, fallback, leakage and ablation checks.
limitations: A local zero-coverage diagnostic validates fallback behavior only; it is not performance evidence.

experiments.title: Frontend evolution (W6-W8)
experiments.question: Can the research and analysis surfaces become a readable, performant product tool without changing strategy contracts?
experiments.decision: The shared warm-white visual system, route structure, export surface and performance work were frozen as the frontend baseline.
experiments.gate: Route, state, HTML export, responsive layout and performance regression contracts.
limitations: Visual completion does not establish strategy performance or production admission.

experiments.title: Deployment optimization and cross-device setup
experiments.question: Can the application run consistently across local platforms and the /strategy subpath while preserving workspace and cache boundaries?
experiments.decision: Cross-platform setup, Nginx subpath deployment, workspace persistence, cache invalidation and performance monitoring were documented and tested.
experiments.gate: Deployment runtime, subpath routing, workspace recovery and cache contract checks.
limitations: Deployment contracts are operational boundaries, not evidence of investment performance.
